# Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse: What Amazon's New Personal AI Devices Do

> **In short:** Amazon has introduced two new Bee devices: Bee Frontier, a wearable for your wrist or clothing, and Bee Eclipse, a card-sized piece that attaches magnetically to your phone. Both turn conversations into summaries and to-dos, and they can connect to Alexa+.

Have you ever agreed on a dinner time with a friend and then lost it by the next morning? Most of us have. Amazon's new Bee devices aim at exactly that problem, by listening for the details you might forget and turning them into notes you can check later.

## What Bee is

Bee is a personal AI, meaning an AI that works for one person rather than a whole company. Amazon describes it as "ambient," which means it runs quietly in the background instead of waiting for you to type a question. Bee picks out the important parts of a conversation and turns them into summaries, to-dos, reminders, and insights.

Amazon says the first Bee device offered more than a plain transcript (a word-for-word text copy of speech). The new devices extend that idea.

## Bee Frontier: a wearable for everyday use

Bee Frontier is the next generation of the wearable. You can wear it on your wrist with a soft silicone band, or clip it onto clothing. It comes in Sage, Lavender, and Onyx.

Amazon lists several practical details:

- **Water resistance**: IP67 is a rating that means the device can handle splashes and brief submersion.
- **Battery**: up to seven days on one charge, charged over USB-C (the same plug style many phones now use).
- **Microphones**: two microphones with noise filtering, so it can focus on speech in a busy restaurant or open office.

Amazon's own example is a simple one: a reminder to buy dish soap that you mentioned in passing.

## Bee Eclipse: the phone attachment

Bee Eclipse is a slim device about the size of a credit card. It attaches magnetically to the back of your phone, so there is nothing to strap on. Amazon says it lasts more than 21 days on one charge.

It works the same way as Bee Frontier. Amazon's example is a phone call where family members plan a trip. Bee Eclipse can help you keep track of arrival times and restaurant picks, so you don't have to write everything down while you're talking.

## Using Bee with Alexa

Amazon says both devices connect to Alexa+, the newer version of its voice assistant. You can ask Alexa for hands-free summaries and to-dos from your conversations.

Separately, Amazon has expanded Alexa for Shopping with more than 100 new capabilities for U.S. customers. You can ask it to create and edit shopping or wedding lists, skip or pause a Subscribe & Save delivery, check your Prime benefits, or ask where a refund is. Amazon also says the assistant can buy an item for you when it reaches a price you set. The announcement doesn't give a shipping date for the Bee devices, so check Amazon's site for current availability.

## Privacy: what Amazon says

Privacy is the first question most people ask about a device that listens. Amazon says:

- Bee processes audio in real time and then deletes it.
- You control when it's listening, with a microphone button on Bee Frontier and a single on-off button on Bee Eclipse.
- A visible light shows when a device is active.
- Bee Frontier can turn itself off after a set period of silence.
- Bee Eclipse asks call participants for permission each time a recording starts.

These are Amazon's own statements about the product. Check the settings and policy pages before you rely on them.

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life**: A device like this could help you remember plans you make in passing, such as coffee dates or errands.
- **For your business or work**: Meeting summaries and to-do lists may help you keep track of follow-ups, as long as you respect the people you record and check your workplace rules first.
- **If you're just getting started**: Decide first where you're comfortable with a listening device, then try the on-off controls before you start relying on summaries.
- **If you already use Alexa for Shopping**: Try a list-building request like "Add all to my baby registry," then ask Alexa what's left, so you can see how it keeps your lists in sync.

## Wrap-up

Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse are Amazon's attempt to make conversations easier to remember. Frontier is a wristband or clip, and Eclipse is a phone attachment. Both can connect to Alexa+, and Amazon says both protect your audio. Before you decide anything, read the privacy and availability details on Amazon's site. Your next step today: open the Alexa app on your phone and look at the device and privacy options you already have.
